lines:
  - id: person.hsa_split
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of this person's Forms 8889 on which line 6 is figured under the rules for spouses who have separate HSAs and had family coverage under an HDHP at any time during 2025"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: f8889
      field: f8889.one
      where: {op: test, eq: [f8889.split, {const: true}]}
    note: "The IRS pages do not define this interface. Chosen reading: a count of this person's Forms 8889 to which the i8889 line 6 rules for spouses with separate HSAs and family coverage apply (f8889.split true)."
  - id: person.hsa_agreed
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Number of this person's Forms 8889 on which the family contribution limit is divided by a different allocation both spouses agree on (not equally)"
    type: Count
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: f8889
      field: f8889.one
      where:
        op: test
        all:
          - {op: test, eq: [f8889.split, {const: true}]}
          - {op: test, eq: [f8889.allocation, {const: "agreed"}]}
    note: "The IRS pages do not define this interface. Chosen reading: a count of the Forms 8889 under the line 6 spouse rules where the division is 'a different allocation' agreed by both spouses instead of the equal division."
  - id: person.hsa_step1
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 1. The contribution limit to be divided between you and your spouse (the refigured line 5 for the months you were treated as having family coverage), total over this person's Forms 8889 under the line 6 spouse rules"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: f8889
      field: f8889.step1
      where: {op: test, eq: [f8889.split, {const: true}]}
    note: "The IRS pages do not define this interface. Chosen reading: the Step 1 amount (i8889 line 6) of this person's Form 8889, counted only where the spouse rules apply (f8889.split true), so that a return-level total can be compared with the allocated shares."
  - id: person.hsa_share
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Step 2. The part of the contribution limit from Step 1 allocated to this person (divided equally between you and your spouse, unless you both agree on a different allocation), total over this person's Forms 8889 under the line 6 spouse rules"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: f8889
      field: f8889.share
      where: {op: test, eq: [f8889.split, {const: true}]}
    note: "The IRS pages do not define this interface. Chosen reading: this person's allocated share of the Step 1 limit (i8889 line 6, Step 2), counted only where the spouse rules apply (f8889.split true)."
  - id: person.x_hsa_excess
    printed: "(helper)"
    label: "Excess of your contributions (made by you or on your behalf) to your HSAs for 2025 from Form 8889, line 2, over your contribution limit (Form 8889, line 12), including any excess contributions your employer made (Form 5329, line 47)"
    type: NonNegDollars
    expr:
      op: sum_over
      collection: f8889
      field: f8889.excess_amt
    note: "Chosen reading: the Form 5329 line 47 amount for this person, taken as the total of the Form 8889 excess contribution amount (f8889.excess_amt, own plus employer excess) over this person's Forms 8889. The 'unless withdrawn' case (i5329 line 47) is not computed here. It is screened by f8889.excess_withdrawn, a field of the nested collection, which is not listed as a refusal on this line because no bound aggregate of it is supplied. A prior-year excess (Form 5329 line 42) is outside this line and is screened by person.x_other."
